title: inference_event v2
description: v2 (MAJOR): renames latency_ms -> latency_total_ms, replaces cache_hit by cache_status, adds request_type (required) and ttft_ms (optional). See migrations/v1_to_v2.json.

event_id.description: Globally unique id generated by the gateway. Idempotency key.

event_ts.description: UTC time the request was received by the gateway (ms precision).

user_id.description: Pseudonymous user key (never an email or name).

request_type.description: Task category used to join model quality evaluations.

latency_total_ms.description: End-to-end gateway latency in milliseconds (was latency_ms).

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds. Null when no token was produced.

cache_status.description: hit = served from cache; miss = cache enabled but not found; bypass = cache disabled for the app.
